reconstruction.scope: Specific Al Bayt Stadium: own native wavy rectangular tent body and rectangular open roof aperture, peaked pale fabric canopy/four principal peaks along each long side and connected curves/renderable red-dark-pale abstract woven lining, two parked arched retractable-roof packets/deep inner truss/radial lattice, horizontal cream/dark fabric stripes/two real recessed red arched entrances/closed glazed services/individual supports and decks, three burgundy-cream bowl bands/two closed box belts/open neutral football floor and supported displays/lights/marks/goals. Four existing shared concrete/paint/canvas/window-grid graphs. Coarsest level expands the simplified seating opening to retain the entire neutral field and merges peak/stripe repetitions. Static open-roof state, no unique texture atlas/copied graphics/hidden furnished rooms/mechanical movement simulation. Independent arrival-loop bridge, exhibition/site buildings, landscape/plaza/water are outside stadium-envelope scope.
